entries.text: This machine is not working safely.
entries.easy_read:
The machine is not safe.
I tell someone now.
distractors: The machine is a bit odd.
errors: waiting to report a safety issue

entries.text: I have stopped work because it is not safe.
entries.easy_read:
It is not safe.
I stopped my work.
I tell my boss.

entries.text: There has been an accident. Please come quickly.
entries.easy_read:
Someone is hurt.
I ask for help now.

entries.text: Someone is hurt near the loading bay.
entries.easy_read:
A person is hurt.
I say where they are.

entries.text: There is a spill on the floor. It is slippery.
entries.easy_read:
The floor is wet.
People can fall.
I tell someone.

entries.text: I do not have the right gloves for this job.
entries.easy_read:
I need safe gloves.
I do not have them.

entries.text: The fire exit is blocked by boxes.
entries.easy_read:
Boxes are in front of the door.
That is not safe.

entries.text: What is the safe way to lift this?
entries.easy_read:
I do not want to hurt myself.
I ask the safe way.

entries.text: I told my supervisor, but it has not been fixed. Who else should I tell?
entries.easy_read:
I told my boss.
Nothing changed.
I ask who else can help.

entries.text: Nobody was hurt, but it nearly caused an accident.
entries.easy_read:
Nothing bad happened.
But it almost did.
I still tell someone.

entries.text: Where should I go if the alarm sounds?
entries.easy_read:
I ask what to do in danger.
I ask where to go.

entries.text: I will need help to leave the building in an emergency.
entries.easy_read:
I cannot leave fast alone.
I need a person to help me.
We plan this before.

entries.text: I cannot hear the alarm. Could we add a flashing light?
entries.easy_read:
I cannot hear the alarm sound.
A flashing light would tell me.

entries.text: I am not feeling well. I need to sit down for a few minutes.
entries.easy_read:
I feel bad.
I need to sit and rest.

entries.text: I have understood the safety rules and I have signed the form.
entries.easy_read:
I learned the safety rules.
I signed the paper.

entries.text: I am not trained for that machine. Could someone trained do it?
entries.easy_read:
Nobody taught me that machine.
It is not safe for me.
Please ask a trained person.
